title: Diamond Head Hike & Oahu Circle Island Tour with Byodo-in Temple
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
We believe your Hawaii vacation deserves more than just a bus ride—it should be an unforgettable experience. Our small-group tours offer a more personal, relaxed atmosphere with friendly local guides who share the stories, culture, and hidden gems of Oahu.
Unlike many tours, we include Diamond Head Hike and Byodo-In Temple admission, plus visits to iconic locations like Dole Plantation, Green World Coffee Farm, Oahu’s legendary North Shore, Kahuku Food Trucks, Chinaman’s Hat, and more—all in one incredible day.
Enjoy complimentary light refreshments, comfortable transportation, and plenty of time to soak in the island’s beauty. We focus on creating memorable experiences, not rushing from stop to stop.

More included. Smaller groups. Local hospitality. An unforgettable day on Oahu.
